text:
sanjay: Quick proposal — enforce a small min on-demand floor per region and use spot burst pools for scaleouts. Aim: reduce baseline cost but avoid tail latencies when spot preempts.

laura: can you spell out numbers? what's 'small'? also worried about kv-cache warmup on preemptions.

sanjay: thinking min_on_demand = 8% of capacity for each GPU instance family, burst pool sized to handle 3x steady load. sketch:
```
pool_policy:
  min_on_demand: 0.08
  spot_burst_target_pct: 300
  preempt_fallback_margin: 0.12
  drain_timeout_s: 90
  regions: ["us-west1","europe-west1"]
```

mike: looks reasonable. two notes: 1) cross-region fallback will spike egress and add latency; 2) we should prefer same-region on-demand before inter-region spot fallback.

olga: agree with mike. Also we need a clear metric for measurable impact: p95 latency, token-cost-per-request, and preempted-request-rate. Can we simulate with last quarter's trace? :bar_chart:

jamie: add graceful preempt handler: mark instance draining, reroute inflight to cached KV shard replicas, and enqueue retriable requests. plus 2-minute TTL for transient spot nodes to avoid thrashing.

sanjay: good call on TTL. proposal updated: add spot_ttl_s = 120 and prefer_local_region: true.

ops-bot: INCIDENTBOT: preemption spikes in eu-west1 yesterday — 22% of spot nodes reclaimed in 6h window. tagging @sanjay

sanjay: noted. that's why min_on_demand matters. if we keep floor at 8% we cover the steady background and reduce N->0 risk.

laura: what about cost math? rough sketch: with 8% floor across europe + us baseline, cost increase ~+6% infra but spot usage covers 72% of spikes, net savings ~22% vs all-on-demand.

mike: can you add a small canary plan? 3% of cluster in eu-west1 with canary config for 48h then expand if p95 stays within 10% of baseline.

sanjay: yes. canary plan: roll out to eu-west1, 3% capacity, 48h, automated rollback if p95 > baseline*1.10 or preempt_rate > 15%.

jamie: i'll draft runbook entries: graceful drain play, cache-warmup window, alert thresholds. put in runbook and run smoke job.

sanjay: owners: jamie (runbook), laura (metrics & eval), mike (network/cost gating), olga (canary verification). I'll open a PR with config and a k8s job to simulate.

deploy-bot: deploy started for canary pool config to eu-west1 (canary-id: canary-202503). watch logs in /deploys/canary-202503

olga: i'll monitor and post snapshots hourly. tagging @oncall to be aware.

laura: one last ask — add explicit quantization profile for spot workloads (lower mem) so we don't oversubscribe GPU memory on preempted nodes.

sanjay: added to PR checklist. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
